newsitem.title: POLAND: POLISH CENTRAL BANK SETS NOV RESERVE MONEY TARGET.
newsitem.headline: POLISH CENTRAL BANK SETS NOV RESERVE MONEY TARGET.

text.p: The National Bank of Poland set November's reserve money target band at 33.29 to 33.99 billion zlotys, the central bank said in a statement on Tuesday.
In October, the target band was set between 32.95 and 33.65 billion zlotys.
The average level of reserve money in September was 32.80 billion zlotys, within the target of 32.54 to 33.24 billion.
Reserve money, also called high powered money, consisits of the cash in circulation, cash in the banks' vaults and obligatory reserves.
Since January 1996, it has served as the central banks' monetary policy operational target, through which it wants to control money supply growth and inflation.
